goal: Maximize the length the snake reaches before the game ends.
description: Snake from the package gymnasium-snake-game, on a 16 by 16 grid. Cells are [x, y], x from 0 (left) to 15, y from 0 (top) to 15. The snake starts with length 5, its head at [8, 8], heading right. The action is an int, the heading: 0 up, 1 down, 2 left, 3 right; an action along the current axis (the same heading or its reverse) keeps the heading. Observables: head is the head's cell; food is the food's cell; body lists the other cells of the snake, from the neck to the tail; heading is the current heading; length is the number of cells. The snake may move into the cell its tail leaves. Eating gives reward 1 and grows the snake by one cell; running into a wall or the body gives reward -10 and ends the game; the game is cut off after 1000 steps.

milestones.name: first_food
milestones.description: the snake eats at least one food

subgoals.name: reach_food
subgoals.description: move the head to the food without dying

strategies.name: greedy
strategies.description: step towards the food along x, then y

strategies.name: safe_greedy
strategies.description: step towards the food, never into a wall or the body

strategies.name: flood_fill
strategies.description: prefer moves that leave the most free cells reachable

strategies.name: tail_chase
strategies.description: follow the tail when the food is not safe to reach
